description: Use this when the user wants to find a used car for sale in Slovakia — by brand, model, body type, fuel, gearbox, year, price, mileage, power or town/district. Covers listings sellers published on AutoIsto directly and public listings from Slovak car portals. Pass the criteria as ONE short phrase in Slovak (Czech also works), with numbers as the user said them. Examples that are fully understood: "škoda octavia kombi diesel automat od 2017 do 15000 €", "suv automat do 25000 €", "bmw x5 diesel od 2019 do 40000 €", "kombi do 10000 € Žilina". Use at most ONE body type per call (kombi, SUV, sedan, hatchback, liftback, van, kupé, kabriolet, dodávka); for two body types make two calls. Leave out filler and wishes that are not filters (rodinné, auto, do mesta, spoľahlivé) and equipment (ťažné, panoráma) — unknown words are not applied and are listed in notUnderstood. Returns up to 10 cars with price verdicts, what was understood, which criteria were relaxed when nothing matched exactly, which words were not applied, and a link to all results. Limits: only cars currently listed on AutoIsto (Slovakia, prices in EUR); no new-car configurators, rentals, leasing offers or cars abroad; the offer changes daily, so a car may already be sold.

query.description: Concrete criteria in Slovak or Czech, e.g. "bmw x5 diesel od 2019 do 40000 €" or "kombi do 10000 € Žilina".

name: search_cars

cars.description: Up to 10 cars, AutoIsto's best-value order (closest to the budget when a budget was given).

comparableCars.description: How many comparable cars the saving is computed from.

id.description: Stable AutoIsto car id; pass it to get_car_details.

location.description: Town or district as stated in the listing.

mileageKm.description: Odometer in km; null = the seller did not state it.

priceSavingEur.description: How much below the median of comparable cars; only set when priceVerdict is below_market.

priceVerdict.description: AutoIsto price verdict against comparable cars (same model, similar year, mileage and version). null = not enough comparable cars, or the price is not a plain sale price (instalment, damaged car).

source.description: Where the listing comes from (portal name, or AutoIsto for a seller's own listing).

url.description: Link to the car on www.autoisto.sk — show it to the user unchanged.

variant.description: Trim / engine as written by the seller, null when it only repeats the model.

notUnderstood.description: Words from the query that were NOT applied as filters (unknown words, two body types at once, equipment). Empty together with empty relaxed = the results match everything in the query.

relaxed.description: Criteria dropped because nothing matched exactly.

totalMatches.description: How many cars in the offer match (after relaxing, if any).

understood.description: Filters AutoIsto read from the phrase, in Slovak (e.g. Škoda, Octavia, do 15 000 €).

title: Search used cars
